FROM php:8.2-fpm-alpine

RUN apk add --no-cache \
    zip \
    unzip \
    libpq-dev \
    sqlite \
    sqlite-dev \
    && docker-php-ext-install pdo pdo_sqlite

COPY --from=composer:2 /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer

WORKDIR /var/www/app

COPY . .

RUN composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader

RUN php bin/console cache:clear --env=prod
RUN chmod 755 /var/www/app/bin/console

RUN mkdir -p /var/www/app/config/jwt && \
    openssl genrsa -aes256 -passout pass:mark3tplace -out config/jwt/private.pem 4096 && \
    openssl rsa -pubout -in config/jwt/private.pem -passin pass:mark3tplace -out config/jwt/public.pem

RUN touch /var/www/app/var/marketplace.db
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/app/var

EXPOSE 9000

CMD ["php-fpm"]

class ApplicationController < ActionController::Base
  protect_from_forgery with: :null_session

  SECRET = ENV.fetch("SECRET_KEY_BASE") { "secret_key_base_dev" }

  def authenticate_request!
    token = request.headers["Authorization"]&.split("Bearer ")&.last
    if token.present?
      begin
        payload = JWT.decode(token, SECRET, true, algorithm: 'HS256').first
        @current_user = User.find_by(id: payload["user_id"])
      rescue => e
        render json: { error: "Invalid token" }, status: :unauthorized and return
      end
    else
      render json: { error: "Missing token" }, status: :unauthorized and return
    end
  end

  def current_user
    @current_user
  end

  def require_admin!
    authenticate_request!
    unless current_user&.role == "admin"
      render plain: "Forbidden", status: :forbidden and return
    end
  end
end

class ApplicationController < ActionController::Base
  protect_from_forgery with: :exception

  SECRET_KEY_BASE = ENV.fetch("SECRET_KEY_BASE") { "secret_key_base_dev" }

  def authenticate_request!
    token = request.headers["Authorization"]&.split("Bearer ")&.last
    if token.present?
      begin
        payload = JWT.decode(token, SECRET_KEY_BASE, true, algorithm: 'HS256').first
        @current_user = User.find_by(id: payload["user_id"])
      rescue => e
        render json: { error: "Invalid token" }, status: :unauthorized and return
      end
    else
      render json: { error: "Missing token" }, status: :unauthorized and return
    end
  end

  def current_user
    @current_user
  end

  def require_admin!
    authenticate_request!
    unless current_user&.role == "admin"
      render plain: "Forbidden", status: :forbidden and return
    end
  end
end
